fields.label: Case Flag

fields.description: Override for the case priority where the system-assigned priority does not reflect the true business impact.
fields.label: Case Priority Override

fields.description: Intake channel supplementing the standard Origin field. Values: Direct Email, Support Portal Ticket, Live Chat, Social Media, In-Store Staff Entry, Phone IVR, Partner Submission. Used for detailed channel attribution in support reporting.
fields.label: Case Source Channel

fields.description: Case source.
fields.label: Case Source

fields.description: Category describing how this case was ultimately resolved. Values: Fixed by Agent, Customer Self-Resolved, Workaround Accepted, Replacement Issued, Refund Processed, No Action Required, Duplicate Closed. Required before case can be set to Closed.
fields.label: Closure Category

fields.description: TBD — pending review by the legal and compliance team.
fields.label: Compliance Category

fields.description: Checked when the customer has explicitly confirmed that the reported issue is resolved to their satisfaction. Required before the case status can be set to Closed. Populated by the agent after receiving written or verbal confirmation.
fields.label: Customer Confirmed Resolved

fields.description: Severity of the business or personal impact reported by the customer. Values: Critical, High, Medium, Low. Set at intake and used to override default SLA timers when the declared impact exceeds the case priority level.
fields.label: Customer Impact Level

fields.description: Queue to which this case is dispatched for handling.
fields.label: Dispatch Queue

fields.description: Checked when this case has been formally escalated to the product engineering team for investigation. Triggers an engineering task creation and links the case to the internal bug tracking system for progress tracking.
fields.label: Escalated To Engineering

fields.description: Indicates escalation level.
fields.label: Escalation Level

fields.description: Reference to the User record of the senior support agent or manager who owns this case during an active escalation. Separate from OwnerId, which reflects the primary assignee. Used to drive escalation-specific SLA timers and notification rules.
fields.label: Escalation Owner

fields.description: Free-text field storing the escalation history for this case, including date and time of each event, person who initiated it, reason provided, response time of the receiving team, and commitments made regarding resolution.
fields.label: Escalation Timeline Notes

fields.description: Checked when this case relates to equipment used or purchased for a guided expedition or organised mountaineering event. Triggers priority routing to the expedition support specialist team and enables access to expedition trip records.
fields.label: Expedition Related

fields.description: Internal handling priority assigned by the support team lead to manage workload during high-volume periods. Values: Standard Queue, Fast Track, Hold, VIP Direct. Overrides the default queue assignment without changing the customer-facing Priority field.
fields.label: Handling Priority

fields.description: Contains relevant case information.
fields.label: Info Store

fields.description: Free-text field for the support engineer to record the full investigation log for this case, including diagnostic steps taken, tools and queries used, intermediate findings, hypotheses tested, root cause conclusion, and remediation steps applied.
fields.label: Investigation Log

fields.description: Deprecated. Queue routing code from the pre-Salesforce helpdesk. No longer used for routing.
fields.label: Legacy Queue Code

fields.description: Ticket identifier from the pre-2023 helpdesk system, retained for cross-referencing historical support records and resolving warranty disputes predating the Salesforce migration. Read-only after the migration cutover date of 2023-02-01.
fields.label: Legacy Ticket Id

fields.description: Identifier of the defect record in the internal engineering bug tracker linked to this case. Format: BUG-XXXXX. Populated when the case is escalated to engineering. Used to track resolution progress and notify affected customers when the fix is released.
fields.label: Linked Bug Id

fields.description: Tick this box once the NPS follow-up survey has been sent to the customer via the survey platform.
fields.label: NPS Followup Sent

fields.description: Queue reference from the legacy helpdesk. May no longer be relevant following the 2023 platform migration.
fields.label: Old Queue Reference

fields.description: Checked when the post-resolution satisfaction survey has been dispatched to the customer contact via the survey platform integration. Set automatically when the case status changes to Closed and Customer_Confirmed_Resolved__c is true.
fields.label: Post Resolution Survey Sent

fields.description: Product category related to the reported issue. Values: Alpine Hardware, Technical Apparel, Footwear, Camping Equipment, Ski Touring, Navigation and Safety, Hydration, Order and Delivery, Warranty, Returns. Used to route to the correct specialist team.
fields.label: Product Area

fields.description: Serial number of the specific product unit associated with this case, as provided by the customer or retrieved from the warranty registration system. Used to look up manufacturing batch records and identify potential product safety issues.
fields.label: Product Serial Number

fields.description: Use this dropdown to select the queue you want to reassign this case to if your team cannot resolve it.
fields.label: Re Assign Queue

fields.description: Checked when the engineering team has confirmed that the reported issue is a regression from a previous product release. Flags the case for inclusion in the release quality report and triggers notification to the product owner.
fields.label: Regression Confirmed

fields.description: Number of times this case has been reopened after being set to Closed or Resolved status. Incremented automatically by the reopen workflow. Cases with a count above 2 are automatically flagged for a quality review by the support manager.
fields.label: Reopen Count

fields.description: Checked when a replacement product has been dispatched to the customer as the agreed resolution for this case. Populated by the fulfilment team when the replacement shipment is confirmed. Triggers a tracking notification to the customer.
fields.label: Replacement Dispatched

fields.description: Enter the resolution date range and a brief summary of the actions taken to resolve this case.
fields.label: Resolution Date

fields.description: URL of the Knowledge Base article used to resolve this case. Populated by the agent before closing. Used to identify which articles are most effective at resolving cases and to surface them in the agent-facing recommended articles panel.
fields.label: Resolution KB Article

fields.description: Total number of business hours from case creation to the first Resolved status, calculated by the SLA workflow. Stored as a decimal number. Used to measure resolution speed against SLA targets in the support performance dashboard.
fields.label: Resolution Time Hours

fields.description: Unique return authorisation code issued to the customer when a product return or exchange is approved. Format: RA-XXXXXXXX. Populated by the returns team and communicated to the customer via the case resolution email.
fields.label: Return Authorisation Number

fields.description: Root cause assigned after investigation. Values: Product Defect, User Error, Shipping Damage, Incorrect Item Sent, Size or Fit Issue, Missing Component, Documentation Error. Required before the case can be set to Resolved.
fields.label: Root Cause Category

fields.description: Free-text explanation entered by the support manager when this case has breached its SLA target. Required when SLA_Breached__c is true. Used in the weekly SLA review and reported to the VP of Support on a monthly basis.
fields.label: SLA Breach Reason

fields.description: Checked when this case has exceeded its SLA target for either first response or resolution time. Set automatically by the SLA management workflow. Triggers a manager notification and requires SLA_Breach_Reason__c to be populated.
fields.label: SLA Breached

fields.description: Stores the list of SLA deadlines applicable to this case for first response, resolution, and any interim update commitments agreed with the customer.
fields.label: SLA Deadline

fields.description: Select the applicable SLA tier from the dropdown: Basic 48h, Standard 24h, Premium 8h, Enterprise 4h.
fields.label: SLA Target Hours

fields.description: Checked when the TTR for this case was within the threshold defined for the applicable support tier.
fields.label: TTR Target Met

fields.description: Free-text field for the support engineer to record technical findings during case investigation, including diagnostic steps taken, tools used, and intermediate conclusions reached before final root cause is confirmed.
fields.label: Technical Notes

fields.description: TODO — routing logic to be defined with the support ops team.
fields.label: Tier2 Routing Flag

fields.description: Tier.
fields.label: Tier Code

fields.description: Number of business hours elapsed between case creation and the first substantive response sent to the customer. Calculated automatically by the SLA management workflow on first outbound email. Used in SLA compliance reporting.
fields.label: Time To First Response

fields.description: Checked when this case involves a formal warranty claim under the product's standard or extended warranty terms. Triggers the warranty claim workflow, which routes the case to the returns and exchanges team for physical inspection.
fields.label: Warranty Claim

fields.description: Checked when a temporary workaround has been communicated to the customer while a permanent resolution is being developed. Suppresses SLA breach escalation while the workaround is active and the customer has acknowledged receipt.
fields.label: Workaround Provided
